title: 第十六章 炉中火
content_zh:
断续藤的苦涩，宁神花的微甘，活络散的辛辣，混杂着医舍固有的陈腐药味，构成了陈默接下来半个月呼吸的主调。

    苏芸离开后，他便严格遵循着她交代的方法用药。断续藤根须煎出的药汁，颜色深褐，味道奇苦无比，还带着一股挥之不去的土腥气，比铁骨草汁液更令人难以忍受。陈默每次都是屏住呼吸，一饮而尽，然后立刻灌下几大口清水，才能压下那股翻涌的呕意。但或许是配伍得当、炮制得法，这药汁下肚后，带来的并非铁骨草那种蛮横的灼热，而是一种温厚、持续的暖意，自胃部缓缓扩散至四肢百骸，尤其是受伤的左肩和胸腹处，能清晰感觉到淤塞的气血似乎在缓慢化开，筋骨的酸痛也在这种温养中一点点消减。

    活络散外敷，配合着清风化瘀膏，效果确实更佳。每次换药，吴医仆解开绷带时，陈默都能看到伤口的变化。左肩那道暗红色的掌印颜色日渐变浅，翻卷的皮肉逐渐收拢，新生的嫩肉呈现健康的粉红色，只是那处凹陷依旧触目惊心。胸腹间的青紫也慢慢褪去，呼吸时不再有明显痛感。

    而每日用宁神花冲泡的茶水，则像一道清凉的溪流，时刻熨帖着他因伤势、疼痛和未知前路而难免起伏的心绪。苏芸说得没错，这宁神花年份和品质确实比清心草好，不仅安神静心，似乎对化解那丝盘踞不去的火毒残余燥气，也有不错的效果。运行周天时，心神更容易沉静，对体内那缕暖流的控制，似乎也精细了一丝。

    他依旧每日坚持吐纳，无论多么艰难。暖流一日日壮大，虽然速度慢得让人心焦，但确实在恢复。胸口那堵“墙”依旧厚重，但暖流冲击时，那“沙沙”的消磨感日益清晰，盘桓的时间也从四五十息，缓慢增加到了接近一炷香（约百息）。他知道，这不仅仅是暖流壮大的缘故，更是因为伤势好转，经脉淤塞减轻，自身气血充盈带来的变化。

    他开始尝试下地走动。最初只能在吴医仆的搀扶下，在医舍内挪几步，便气喘吁吁，左肩痛得冷汗涔涔。但他坚持每日增加一点点距离。五步，十步，从床边到门口，再从门口到小院晒太阳的那张矮凳。

    孙小海的腿伤也在好转，夹板已经拆了，能拄着拐杖慢慢走动。他见陈默恢复得慢，性子又急，便自告奋勇当起了“监工”，每日催促陈默多走几步，还把自己偷偷藏下的半个硬馍馍分给陈默，美其名曰“补身子”。陈默推辞不过，也就接了，心里那点因长久卧床和前途未卜而生的阴郁，被这少年笨拙的善意驱散了些许。

    这日，陈默终于能独自慢慢走到院中矮凳坐下，虽然依旧需要右手扶着门框墙壁借力，左臂虚垂着不敢用力，但已是巨大的进步。午后的阳光暖融融地洒在身上，带着暮春将尽的、慵懒的热力。他微微眯起眼，看着墙角那几丛在微风里摇曳的、苏芸上次指给他看的普通药草（止血藤和一种安神的夜交藤），心里默默复述着它们的特征和效用。

    “陈默哥！你看谁来了！”孙小海拄着拐杖，从屋里蹦出来，压低声音，带着掩饰不住的兴奋。

    陈默转头，只见院门处，苏芸的身影再次出现。她今天换了身略新的粗布衣裙，依旧是素净的浅色，头发用一根木簪绾着，挎着一个比上次略大的竹篮。她看到陈默坐在院中，脚步顿了顿，随即走了过来，目光在陈默脸上和虚垂的左臂上扫过。

    “能走动了？”她问，语气平淡。

    “嗯，慢些。”陈默点头，想要起身，被苏芸以眼神制止。

    “坐着吧。”她在旁边另一张矮凳上坐下，将竹篮放在脚边。孙小海好奇地凑过来，被苏芸淡淡看了一眼，顿时缩了缩脖子，讪讪地退开几步，却又不舍得走远，竖起耳朵听着。

    “脸色比上次好些，但气血依旧亏虚得厉害。左臂如何？”苏芸问。

    “不敢用力，抬臂过肩便痛。”陈默如实道。

    苏芸伸出一根手指，轻轻搭在陈默完好的右手腕脉上。她的手指微凉，触感细腻。陈默身体几不可察地僵了一下，随即放松。苏芸垂着眼帘，似在仔细感知，片刻后松开手。

    “内腑伤势已无大碍，经脉淤塞也化开大半。唯左肩筋骨之伤，非短期可愈。你体内那缕灵力……”她抬眼，看向陈默，“比上次浑厚了些，但运行滞涩，尤其过膻中时，阻力极大，可是旧伤未清，还是功法本身有碍？”

    陈默心中微震。苏芸并未修炼出灵力（或极其隐晦），却能通过搭脉隐约感知到他体内灵力的状况，甚至能判断出膻中穴的滞涩，这份感知力，着实惊人。他沉默了一下，道：“应是旧伤及火毒影响，加之功法粗浅。”

    他没有完全说实话。胸口那堵“墙”，是他四灵根资质和《引气诀》品级限制的共同结果，与伤势有关，但非主因。不过，苏芸的判断已足够准确。
content_en:
The bitterness of Dipsacus vine, the slight sweetness of Ningshen flower, and the spiciness of Huoluo powder, mixed with the inherent smell of ancient medicine in the hospital, constituted the main theme of Chen Mo's breathing for the next half month.

After Su Yun left, he strictly followed the method of medication she instructed.The concoction made by decoction of the roots of the vine is dark brown in color and has an extremely bitter taste. It also has a lingering earthy smell, which is more unbearable than the juice of the iron bone grass.Chen Mo held his breath every time, drank it all in one gulp, and then immediately drank several large gulps of water to suppress the surging nausea.But perhaps due to the proper combination and preparation, after the concoction is taken down, what it brings is not the overbearing heat of Iron Bone Grass, but a kind of gentle and continuous warmth, which slowly spreads from the stomach to the limbs, especially the injured left shoulder and chest and abdomen. It can be clearly felt that the blocked qi and blood seem to be slowly dissolving, and the soreness of the muscles and bones is also gradually reduced by this kind of warmth.

The effect of external application of Huoluo Powder and Qingfeng Huayu Ointment is indeed better.Every time the dressing was changed and Dr. Wu took off the bandage, Chen Mo could see the changes in the wound.The dark red palm print on the left shoulder gradually became lighter in color, and the rolled skin gradually closed in. The new tender meat showed a healthy pink color, but the depression was still shocking.The bruises on the chest and abdomen gradually faded away, and there was no obvious pain when breathing.

The tea brewed with Ningshen flower every day is like a cool stream, always calming his unavoidable ups and downs due to injuries, pain and the unknown future.Su Yun was right. The age and quality of this Ningshen Flower are indeed better than those of Qingxincao. Not only does it soothe the mind, it also seems to have a good effect on resolving the residual dryness of the fire poison that lingers.When running the Zhoutian, it is easier to calm down the mind, and the control of the warm current in the body seems to be a little more refined.

He still insists on breathing every day, no matter how difficult it is.The warm current is getting stronger day by day, and although it is worryingly slow, it is indeed recovering.The "wall" on the chest is still thick, but when the warm current hits, the "rustling" feeling becomes increasingly clear, and the lingering time slowly increases from forty to fifty breaths to close to one stick of incense (about a hundred breaths).He knew that this was not only due to the strengthening of the warm current, but also due to the improvement of his injuries, the reduction of congestion in his meridians, and the changes caused by his own qi and blood.

He started trying to get around.At first, he could only move a few steps in the hospital with the help of Dr. Wu's servant, but then he was out of breath, and his left shoulder was so painful that he was sweating.But he insisted on increasing the distance a little every day.Five steps, ten steps, from the bed to the door, and then from the door to the low bench in the courtyard where he was basking in the sun.

Sun Xiaohai's leg injury is also improving. The splint has been removed and he can walk slowly with crutches.Seeing that Chen Mo was recovering slowly and being impatient, he volunteered to be a "supervisor", urging Chen Mo to walk a few more steps every day, and even gave Chen Mo half of the hard buns he had secretly hidden, euphemistically calling it "replenishing the body."Chen Mo couldn't refuse, so he accepted it. The gloominess in his heart caused by being bedridden for a long time and having an uncertain future was somewhat dispelled by the boy's clumsy kindness.

On this day, Chen Mo was finally able to walk slowly to the low bench in the courtyard and sit down on his own. Although he still had to hold on to the door frame and wall with his right hand for strength, and his left arm was hanging down and he did not dare to use force, it was a huge improvement.The afternoon sun shone warmly on my body, bringing with it the lazy heat of late spring.He narrowed his eyes slightly and looked at the common herbs Su Yun pointed out to him last time (hemostatic vine and a soothing night vine) at the few bushes in the corner swaying in the breeze, silently repeating their characteristics and effects in his mind.

"Brother Chen Mo! Look who's here!" Sun Xiaohai jumped out of the room on crutches, lowering his voice with unconcealable excitement.

Chen Mo turned around and saw Su Yun's figure reappearing at the courtyard gate.Today she changed into a slightly new coarse cloth dress, still in a plain light color. Her hair was tied with a wooden hairpin, and she was carrying a bamboo basket that was slightly larger than last time.When she saw Chen Mo sitting in the courtyard, she paused, then walked over, her eyes sweeping over Chen Mo's face and hanging left arm.

"Are you able to move around?" she asked, her tone flat.

"Well, slow down." Chen Mo nodded and wanted to get up, but Su Yun stopped him with a look.

"Sit down." She sat down on another low stool next to her and placed the bamboo basket at her feet.Sun Xiaohai came over curiously and was glanced at by Su Yun. He immediately shrank his neck and took a few steps away, but was unwilling to go far and listened with open ears.

"My face looks better than last time, but my energy and blood are still severely deficient. How is my left arm?" Su Yun asked.

"Don't dare to exert force, it will hurt when you lift your arms over your shoulders." Chen Mo said truthfully.

Su Yun stretched out a finger and gently placed it on Chen Mo's intact right wrist vein.Her fingers were slightly cool and delicate to the touch.Chen Mo's body stiffened almost imperceptibly, and then relaxed.Su Yun lowered her eyes, seeming to feel carefully, and then let go of her hand after a moment.

"The injuries to the internal organs are no longer serious, and most of the congestion in the meridians has been resolved. Only the injuries to the muscles and bones of the left shoulder cannot be healed in a short period of time. The spiritual power in your body..." She raised her eyes and looked at Chen Mo, "It is a bit thicker than last time, but the movement is stagnant, especially when it passes through the middle of the body, the resistance is great. But the old injury has not been cleared, or is it the technique itself that is hindering it?"

Chen Mo was slightly shocked.Su Yun had not developed spiritual power (or it was extremely obscure), but she could vaguely sense the status of the spiritual power in his body through taking pulses, and could even judge the stagnation of the Tanzhong point. This perception was truly astonishing.He was silent for a moment and said: "It should be due to old injuries and fire poison, coupled with the shallowness of the technique."

He wasn't entirely telling the truth.The "wall" on his chest was the result of his four spiritual root qualifications and the level restrictions of "Qi-Entraining Technique". It was related to the injury, but it was not the main cause.However, Su Yun's judgment was accurate enough.
